claims: The Artemis 2 crew successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego.
The Artemis 2 splashdown occurred on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET.
8:07 p.m. ET corresponds to 0007 GMT April 11.
Artemis II Flight Day 10 marked the return of the Crew Dragon "Orion".
The Crew Dragon "Orion" returned after a 10-day trip around the Moon.
